title: @wentale polymers into monomers moments into time moon but a fairy ring floating on hypha Souls so enshrined whisps of chitin slip away truth wafting
summary: @wentale polymers into monomers moments into time moon but a fairy ring floating on hypha Souls so enshrined whisps of chitin slip away truth wafting from our Flower Moon threads of fallen stars wrapping roots in our mind #clmooc #smallpoems #flowermoon
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@wentale
polymers into monomers
moments into time
moon but
a fairy ring
floating on hypha
Souls
so enshrined

whisps of chitin
slip away
truth wafting from
our Flower Moon
threads of fallen
stars wrapping
roots in our mind
#clmooc
#smallpoems
#flowermoon
